intro: Welcome to Hawaii Studio! Please read our rules before chatting, ordering, or working with us. Use the dropdown below to view every category.
note: Breaking these rules will result in moderation. Staff may act on anything that harms the community, even if it isn't listed. — Hawaii Studio

sections.name: Discord Rules
sections.description: How everyone is expected to act
rules: Be respectful. No harassment, hate speech, discrimination, or starting drama.
No spamming, excessive caps, mass pinging, or flooding channels.
No advertising or self-promotion, including in DMs, unless staff approve it.
Keep everything SFW. No NSFW, gore, or disturbing content, including in profiles and statuses.
Don't impersonate staff, developers, or other members.
Use channels for their purpose and keep conversations on topic.
Follow the [Discord Terms of Service](https://discord.com/terms) and [Community Guidelines](https://discord.com/guidelines).
Staff decisions are final. Appeal through a ticket, not in public chat.

sections.name: Voice Chat Rules
rules: No loud noises, earrape, soundboards, or voice changers.
Don't talk over people or interrupt on purpose.
Never record or stream anyone without their permission.
Only play music in music channels.
Staff may move or disconnect you to keep calls running smoothly.

sections.name: Studio & Asset Rules
sections.description: Protecting our work and our creators
rules: Never leak, share, or screenshot unreleased studio work without permission.
No stealing, reuploading, or reselling studio models, scripts, UI, or other assets.
Never share backdoored or malicious models, plugins, or scripts. This is an instant ban.
Give credit when you use or build on someone else's work.
Keep feedback constructive. Critique the work, not the person.
Keep project discussion in the right channels.

sections.name: Commission & Payment Rules
sections.description: Ordering from or working with the studio
rules: All commissions go through a ticket. Don't DM developers to place orders.
Agree on the price, what's included, and the deadline in your ticket before work starts.
Only pay using the methods staff give you in your ticket.
Chargebacks or scamming result in a permanent ban.
Finished work isn't handed over until it's fully paid for.
Revisions are limited to what was agreed in your ticket.

sections.name: Roblox Rules
rules: Follow the [Roblox Terms of Use](https://www.roblox.com/info/terms) and Community Standards.
No exploiting, cheating, or sharing exploit scripts.
No buying, selling, or trading Roblox accounts, items, or Robux outside official Roblox systems.
Never ask for or share passwords, cookies, or 2-step verification codes.
Don't use alt accounts to get around bans, here or in our games.
